what: a green slime: the foul dungeon slime that hangs from damp ceilings and lets go, painted with depth, weight and grime, never a sweet. It is one big heavy gob of thick, wet, opaque slime caught in mid-air as it falls. Its upper part is one thick rounded mass, complete and rounded over the top, soft all over, its skin smooth, wet and unbroken, sagging under its own weight. From this mass the slime sags and pours downward into four or five long fat strands and heavy drops of different lengths, the longest stretching far down, every strand ending in a fat drop well inside the picture. The slime is murky and dirty, not clear: dark pond-scum green, nearly black-green in its depths, with dull wet highlights along its curves and a few streaks of dirty brown running down it. Nothing shows through it and nothing is in it. It is only slime, the same all over.
colours: dark murky pond-scum green and black-green opaque slime, with duller yellow-green only on the wet highlights, and dirty brown streaks. Dull and dirty all over.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: It falls through the air, small in the middle of the picture with wide empty backdrop above its rounded top and on every side; it is lopsided, its longest strand of slime stretching down and to the left with a fat drop swelling at its tip, the shorter strands swinging beside it.
must_show: a falling gob of slime: a rounded mass on top, fat strands and drops below
dark, murky, dirty green, opaque: not bright, not glassy
the whole thing inside the picture, backdrop above it
no face at all
nothing under it
must_not_show: slime touching the top edge of the picture
strands running off the bottom of the picture

what: a gibbering slime: a heap of pale jelly covered in mouths, none of them finished, all of them talking, painted with depth, weight and grime, dreadful and never cute. It is one rounded mound of thick cloudy jelly, soft all over, wider than it is tall, lopsided and sagging, with a front lip curling forward at the left. The jelly is dirty grey-white, murky, with grey-brown shadows in its depths and dull wet highlights, never clean and never bright. Set directly in the jelly, scattered at odd angles, are four big gaping mouths and nothing else: each mouth is as wide as a quarter of the whole mound, a ragged lipless hole stretched open, ringed with long, crooked, uneven grey-ivory teeth, and the inside of each is only pitch-black darkness. The mouths are of different sizes and gape in different directions, one near the top, one at the front, two on the side. Thick strands of jelly stretch across the corners of the mouths.
colours: dirty grey-white cloudy jelly with grey-brown murky shadows and dull pale highlights; long grey-ivory teeth; pitch-black mouth insides.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The mound heaves and leans to the left, piled higher on the right side, its front lip of jelly lifted and curling forward over empty air, the four mouths gaping wide at different angles. It is one compact mass with a clean lower edge.
must_show: a lopsided mound of dirty grey-white jelly, plainly slime
four big gaping lipless mouths with long crooked teeth, black inside, readable in the small sprite
no eyes anywhere
murky and grimy: not a clean white pudding

what: a gibbering mouther: a heap of soft dead-looking flesh that pours across the floor, covered in eyes and mouths that open wherever they please, painted with depth, weight and grime, dreadful and never cute. It is one single smooth-topped mound of loose grey hide, like a great heap of wet dough gone grey, wider than it is tall, sagging and wrinkled, with one unbroken rounded outline and no lumps or knobs sticking out of it. It is not a head, it is not a pile of heads, and it has no face anywhere. Opening straight out of its flat surface, each one alone, are three huge mouths and four huge eyeballs, and no mouth has eyes above it. One mouth lies across the very top of the mound, gaping straight up at the sky. One mouth is a tall upright gash down the left side, open sideways. One mouth is a wide gash low on the right side, hanging open. Each mouth is as wide as a third of the mound: a ragged lipless hole ringed with long, thick, sharp, uneven ivory fangs, each fang as long as an eyeball is wide, round a pitch-black inside. Between the mouths, far apart from one another, sit the four eyeballs, each one alone and each staring a different way: one in the very middle of the mound, one near the upper right edge, one near the lower left edge and one at the bottom in the middle. Each eyeball is as wide as a quarter of the mound, as big as the mouths are wide, round, bulging and bloodshot, with a dull sickly yellow iris and a narrow black slit of a pupil, sunk in a wrinkled pit of grey hide. The mound ends below in one clean rounded edge tucked under itself, with nothing spreading out sideways from it. The whole mound is wholly inside the picture, with clear backdrop above it, below it and on both sides.
colours: corpse-grey loose wrinkled hide, the cold mid-grey of a drowned man, with dark grey-brown blotches and deep dark creases, on every part; four big dull sickly yellow eyeballs with black slit pupils; long ivory fangs; pitch-black mouth insides.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: It slumps and pours to the left, its mass heaped high at the back and sagging forward in one low rounded lip at the left, its three mouths gaping in three different directions, each of its four eyes staring a different way. It is one compact mass with a clean lower edge.
must_show: one single shapeless mound of corpse-grey wrinkled hide with a smooth unbroken outline: dead flesh, not bread and not jelly
three huge fanged mouths and four huge eyeballs, each alone, scattered and pointing different ways
never a face and never a heap of heads: no mouth with a pair of eyes above it, no snouts or muzzles sticking out
eyes and fangs readable in the small sprite
bulkier and more dreadful than the pale gibbering slime
must_not_show: pair of eyes above a mouth
skirt of slime spreading on the ground
flat base running off the picture

what: a gnoll: a lean, rangy, hunched man-shaped creature with the head of a real spotted hyena: a broad blunt black muzzle, powerful jaws with big yellowed teeth, small round ears and a short stiff crest of dark hair down the back of the neck. Its whole body is furred: chest, belly, arms and legs are covered in short coarse dull grey-buff fur, the pale dusty colour of dry grass, with dark brown spots. It has sloping shoulders, long arms, and clawed feet. It has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs.
colours: dull grey-buff fur, the pale dusty colour of dry grass, with large dark brown spots, over the whole body; a black muzzle and black lower legs; a dark brown neck crest; yellow eyes; yellowed teeth; a ragged tunic of dark mud-brown hide, the colour of wet peat; a spear with a plain dark wooden shaft and a grey flint head.
wears: It wears one ragged sleeveless tunic of dark mud-brown hide that covers its chest and belly and hangs to its thighs, tied at the waist with a strip of hide. Its furred arms and legs are bare. It has no armour, no helmet, no paint and no trophies.
holds: It holds exactly one spear in both hands: a thick plain wooden shaft as tall as itself with a big broad leaf-shaped grey flint head. Both hands grip the shaft and it holds nothing else.
pose: It lopes to the left on two legs, leaning forward with knees bent, both hands thrusting the spear forward and low so the big spearhead is clear on the left, its jaws wide open in a cackle.
must_show: a spotted hyena's head on a furred man-shaped body, on two legs
one spear held in both hands
the plainest gnoll
dusty grey-buff fur with dark spots on arms and legs, not yellow and not orange
one ragged dark hide tunic over the chest, no armour

what: a gnoll fang of Yeenoghu, a sworn fanatic of the gnoll packs: a tall, rangy, long-limbed, upright man-shaped creature with the head of a real spotted hyena: a broad blunt black muzzle, powerful jaws with long yellowed fangs, small round ears and a tall stiff crest of hair down the back of the neck, the crest dyed bright red. One broad band of bright red paint, as wide as two fingers, runs straight across its forehead from ear to ear above the eyes. Its whole body is furred: head, arms, belly and legs are covered in short coarse dull grey-buff fur, the pale dusty colour of dry grass, with dark brown spots. It stands taller and straighter than a plain gnoll, with long legs, long arms and a lean waist. It has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: dull grey-buff fur, the pale dusty colour of dry grass, with large dark brown spots, over the whole body, a black muzzle and black lower legs, one bright red band of paint across the forehead and a bright red neck crest, yellow eyes, yellowed fangs, a sleeveless coat of dark brown boiled leather with dull iron studs, a dark red hide kilt, a flail with a dark wooden handle, a black iron chain and a black iron spiked ball.
wears: It wears a sleeveless coat of thick dark brown boiled leather set with rows of dull iron studs, which covers its chest and belly from the collar to the belt, a wide black belt, and a dark red hide kilt to the knees. Its furred arms are bare. It has no helmet, no metal plate and no necklace.
holds: It holds exactly one flail in its right hand, gripped low beside its right hip: a short thick dark wooden handle as long as its forearm; from the top end of the handle hangs a short thick black chain of three big oval links, and on the chain one black iron ball as big as its fist, covered in short blunt spikes. The chain and ball hang straight down in front of its red kilt and its right thigh, lying against its body, the ball overlapping the kilt. Its left hand is empty: a clawed furred hand reaching out ahead.
pose: It strides to the left on two long legs, upright, with its weight on its front foot and its back leg stretched behind, its head thrust forward with the jaws wide open snarling, its empty clawed left hand reaching out ahead, its right hand gripping the flail handle low at its hip with the chain and spiked ball hanging down against its kilt.
must_show: a hyena-headed spotted gnoll on two legs, tall and rangy like its kin, not squat
a bright red band across the brow and a red crest, readable in the small sprite
a studded dark leather coat covering the chest, and a dark red kilt
one flail: handle, short chain and spiked ball, the ball joined to the figure
empty left hand
dusty grey-buff spotted fur like its kin, not yellow
must_not_show: ball flying in the air apart from the body

what: a gnoll alpha of Yeenoghu: the pack lord of the gnolls, the tallest and heaviest gnoll, a long-limbed, deep-chested, stooping man-shaped creature with the head of a huge real spotted hyena: a long broad scarred black muzzle, enormous jaws with long fangs, small round torn ears, eyes that glow ember red, and a great shaggy black mane standing up from its skull and running down its neck and back. Its whole body is furred like a hyena's: its chest, belly, arms and legs are covered in coarse dark grey-brown fur, the colour of dry bark, marked all over with big black spots, darker than a plain gnoll's. Its arms are very long and thick. It has a small head for its body, very wide shoulders and long legs.
colours: dark grey-brown fur, the colour of dry bark, with big black spots over the whole body, a shaggy black mane, a black muzzle and black lower legs, ember-red eyes, a great axe made of one pale ivory thighbone with dark iron bands and a dark iron blade, a heavy rusted iron collar and iron wrist cuffs with short broken chains, a necklace of big ivory fangs, a sleeveless coat and kilt of black hide.
wears: It wears a heavy rusted iron collar round its neck and a rusted iron cuff on each wrist, each cuff with two or three broken links of chain hanging from it; a sleeveless coat of thick black hide that covers its chest and belly from the collar to the belt; a necklace of big ivory fangs lying across the black coat; a mantle of black hide over its humped shoulders; and a black hide kilt with a wide belt hung with two small skulls.
holds: It holds exactly one great axe in both hands: its shaft is one enormous pale ivory thighbone, thicker than its arm and as long as its body, with a big knobbed joint at each end, and bound to the top end with three dark iron bands is one huge broad rough dark iron axe blade. Both hands grip the bone shaft and it holds nothing else.
pose: It lopes to the left on two long bent legs, stooping forward with its head low and thrust out ahead, both long arms hauling the bone axe up over its right shoulder for a downward chop, the iron blade high and clear above its back, jaws wide open howling.
must_show: a hyena-headed gnoll: long black muzzle, round ears, spotted fur on chest and arms
the biggest of the three, with a shaggy black mane and red eyes
one great axe with a thighbone shaft and iron blade, in both hands
iron collar and wrist cuffs with broken chain links
fang necklace and skull trophies: the most adorned gnoll
dark grey-brown spotted fur, not orange, and a black hide coat over the chest

what: a goblin warpriest: a gaunt, stooped, sinister old goblin priest, painted seriously as a real and dangerous creature, never comic. He is small, thin and hunched like other goblins, with dull olive-green skin, long pointed ears, a long hooked nose, hollow cheeks, deep wrinkles, and cold narrow yellow eyes under a heavy brow. His thin lips are pressed shut in a hard sneer. He has the lean proportions of a small wiry old creature with a small head.
colours: dull olive-green skin, a long ragged charcoal-black robe, a deep charcoal-black hood, a long bone-white stole with dark stitched signs, a string of small grey-brown bones, a dull tarnished brass censer ball on a dark iron rod, yellow eyes.
wears: He wears a long ragged charcoal-black robe to his ankles with wide torn sleeves, and a deep charcoal-black hood drawn up over his head, his long green ears sticking out through slits at its sides and his hooked nose and yellow eyes showing in its shadow. Over the robe a long narrow bone-white stole hangs down the front from both shoulders, stitched with dark signs, and a string of small grey-brown bones hangs at his neck. He has no armour and no hat.
holds: He holds exactly one censer-mace, in his right hand, and it is the only thing he holds: a short thick dark iron rod as long as his forearm, and fixed on its top end one round dull tarnished brass ball as big as his own head, pierced with rows of round holes. His left hand is empty: a thin green clawed hand, open, with its bare palm turned to the viewer and its five fingers spread wide, thrust out ahead of him, nothing in it and nothing near it.
pose: On two legs, he strides forward to the left, stooped, with his weight on his front foot and his robe swinging, his right arm raised with the brass censer-mace swung up above his shoulder ready to strike, his empty left hand thrust out ahead with the bare palm open and the fingers spread, his hooded head lowered and glaring.
must_show: goblin (green skin, long ears, hooked nose, small hunched body)
a dark hooded robe and a long pale stole: plainly a priest
one censer-mace: a pierced brass ball on a short rod, in the right hand only
an empty open left hand
grim and sinister, mouth shut: not comic
must_not_show: cloud of smoke around the body

what: a goblin kingslayer: a small, lean, wiry goblin master assassin, a runt with dark olive-green skin, long pointed ears, a narrow scarred face, a long sharp nose, cold narrowed yellow eyes and a thin closed smirking mouth. He is small like other goblins but straight-backed, neat and deadly, not ragged.
colours: dark olive-green skin, close-fitting black leather armour with dull silver buckles, a charcoal-grey cowl and short cloak, a short sword with a grey steel blade wet with bright yellow-green venom, a small dented gold crown hanging at the belt, black boots.
wears: He wears a fitted suit of black leather assassin's armour with dull silver buckles, black leather bracers, soft black boots, and a charcoal-grey cowl and short cloak; the cowl is drawn up over his head but his whole green face shows plainly and his long ears stick out through slits at its sides. From his belt at his hip hangs one small dented gold king's crown, a trophy.
holds: He holds exactly one short sword in his right hand: a broad straight grey steel blade as long as his forearm, its edge coated with bright yellow-green venom that drips from the point. His left hand is empty, an open gloved hand held low behind him for balance.
pose: He glides to the left on two legs in a low, long assassin's lunge, front knee deeply bent and back leg stretched out, his right arm thrust straight ahead with the venomed short sword pointing left, his empty left hand out behind, cloak streaming back.
must_show: goblin (green skin, long ears, small body)
fitted black leather and a grey cowl: neat and deadly, not ragged
one short sword with yellow-green venom on the blade
empty left hand
plainly the most dangerous goblin, without being a king

what: a wood golem: an old wooden guardian statue come to life, a tall, heavy, broad door-warden carved by a medieval woodcarver from dark seasoned oak and pegged together at the joints. Every part of it is dark carved oak, painted as real old timber with grain, long splits, knots, chisel cuts and worn rounded edges. It is carved in the likeness of a stern sentinel in a long belted wooden coat: the head is a carved oak head with a flat carved cap, a heavy carved brow, deep-cut shadowed eye hollows, a long wedge nose and a grim straight slot of a mouth, all hard carved planes of wood; the chest and the long coat skirt are one great carved oak trunk with straight carved folds; the arms are thick carved oak limbs that are separate pieces, joined to the trunk at the shoulders and jointed at the elbows by big round wooden pegs with a dark gap at each joint; the legs are thick carved oak posts jointed at the knees by pegs, on heavy block feet; the fists are heavy carved oak mallet-heads. One large rune, a circle crossed by a zigzag, is burned black into the middle of the chest, a charred scorched mark. Two old broken arrow shafts stick in its shoulder. It has realistic proportions with a small head and wide shoulders.
colours: dark brown and grey-brown weathered oak on every part with black-brown grain, cracks and joint gaps, pale tan worn edges and fresh splits, one charred black rune on the chest; no flesh colour anywhere.
wears: It wears nothing: the coat and cap are carved from the same oak as the rest of it.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing: two heavy carved oak fists.
pose: It steps forward to the left on two legs with a heavy stride, front knee bent, its right fist raised high above its head to slam down, its left arm swung out low in front, its body leaning into the blow.
must_show: a tall heavy statue of dark carved oak: grain, cracks and chisel cuts on every part, head included
separate limbs joined by round wooden pegs with dark gaps at shoulders, elbows, knees
a stern carved wooden face of hard planes, not a living face and not dot eyes
one black burned rune on the chest
empty wooden fists, one raised
painted, old and heavy: not a toy, puppet or cartoon
must_not_show: bark all over like a treant

what: a clay golem: the Golem of Prague, a huge crude figure that a potter built by hand from river mud, come to life. Every part of it is the same clay and nothing else: it is a clay figure roughly in the shape of a hulking man wrapped in a long heavy apron, and it shows no muscles, no skin, no cloth and no bone anywhere. It is twice as broad as a man, hunched and neckless. From its shoulders to its shins it is one thick heavy bell-shaped slab of clay, smeared roughly flat by hand, with no buttons, no collar and no seams, only the potter's long finger-drag grooves running down it, big thumb dents, and one thick rope of twisted clay round the middle. All over the slab, the arms and the head runs a bold web of wide deep cracks, black against the pale clay, like the cracks in the bed of a dried-up pond, splitting the surface into big curling plates, so the whole figure is plainly dried mud. Its head is small for its body, a rough round clay lump sunk between the great round shoulders, hairless and earless, lumpy and lopsided, with a face only roughed in by a thumb: a thick overhanging brow ridge, two dark round pebbles pressed into the clay for eyes, a flat pressed lump for a nose and one grim straight gouged line for a mouth. Its arms are enormous, thicker than its legs and reaching to its knees: plain thick rolls of clay with no shapes on them, swelling into great lumpen clay fists like mittens. Below the slab stand two short thick clay pillars on broad flat pads. Flakes of pale dry crust peel from its shoulders and fists.
colours: pale dried river clay, a dusty grey-buff, on every part, head, apron slab, arms and feet alike, with a bold web of wide black cracks all over it and darker grey-brown damp clay in the grooves and under the arms; two dark pebble eyes.
wears: It wears nothing: the apron shape and the rope round its middle are modelled in the same pale cracked clay as the rest of it.
holds: It holds nothing: its two great lumpen clay hands are empty.
pose: It lumbers to the left on its two pillar legs, its whole mass leaning forward, its right fist swung up high above its head to smash down, its left fist hanging low and forward, its small head lowered between its shoulders.
must_show: a massive hunched brute made wholly of pale dried river clay, head included
a bold web of wide black cracks all over it, plain in the small sprite: dried mud, painted with weight
a body that is one heavy apron-shaped slab of clay with a twisted clay rope: no chest, no belly, no muscle
a small lumpy roughed-in clay head: brow ridge, two pebble eyes, gouged mouth; not a skull
enormous empty clay fists, one raised
told from the carved-oak wood golem by its pale cracked mud surface and lumpy make

what: a flesh golem: Frankenstein's creature, a very tall, heavy-boned, gaunt, broad-shouldered man built from the parts of dead men and sewn together. He is dead flesh, cold ash-grey and slate-grey, greyer than any living man: the skin of his face, neck, chest and hands is made of mismatched patches, some pale ash-grey and some dark slate-grey, with a clear edge where a pale patch meets a dark one. Long seams of thick black stitches, bold as bootlaces, join the patches: one seam straight across his forehead, one down his left cheek to his jaw, one round his neck, one straight down the middle of his chest, and one round each wrist. A row of dull iron staples crosses his brow. He has a long heavy square-topped head with a high flat brow, lank black hair, sunken cheeks, a grim down-turned mouth and deep-set dull yellow eyes full of grief and anger. His hands are huge and do not match: one is bigger and darker than the other. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold ash-grey and dark slate-grey patched dead skin, thick black stitches, dull iron staples, lank black hair, dull yellow eyes, a torn black-brown wool coat, ragged dark brown trousers, heavy black boots.
wears: He wears a torn, too-small, black-brown wool coat with the sleeves ending at the forearms, hanging open over his stitched grey chest, ragged dark brown trousers and heavy black boots. He has no armour and no chains.
holds: His hands are empty and he holds nothing: two huge mismatched stitched grey hands with the fingers spread.
pose: He lurches forward to the left on two stiff legs, nearly straight at the knees, with one long stride, his body leaning, his right arm stretched out ahead with the great hand open to seize, his left arm drawn back with the hand clawed to rend, head lowered, mouth open in a groan.
must_show: a tall gaunt stitched man of dead grey flesh, no living pink
patches of different greys joined by thick black stitches, on the face too
high flat brow with iron staples, lank black hair
torn dark coat and trousers
huge empty hands, one reaching
sorrowful and terrible, not a comic monster
must_not_show: bare chest only in a loincloth
both arms spread out to the sides

what: a shield guardian: a hulking bodyguard that a wizard's smiths built of old bronze, oak and stone, with no flesh anywhere, painted seriously with weight. It is made like an enormous suit of armour in the shape of a hunched guardsman, with nobody inside: big overlapping plates of old bronze, riveted along their edges, with black gaps at every joint. It is hunched and neckless, twice as broad as a man, its arms thicker than its legs. Its head is small and sunk between two great rounded bronze shoulder plates: a plain closed bronze helm with a flat top and one dark level eye slit across it, and nothing else. Its chest is one broad bronze plate with a round dull red gem as big as a fist set in the middle of it, held by four bronze claws. Through the gaps at its elbows, waist and knees show thick dark oak beams, the frame it is built on. Its right arm ends in one great fist that is a rough block of grey stone. Its left forearm has no hand: built onto it is one great round shield as wide as its body, of thick dark oak planks with a broad bronze rim and a raised bronze boss in the middle. That is its only shield. Its feet are heavy blocks of grey stone. Everything is old: the bronze is gone dark brown with age, dented and scratched, with a little green tarnish in the rivet lines.
colours: old dark bronze plates on the head, shoulders, chest, arms and legs, the brown-gold of tarnished brass, nearly black in the hollows, with a dull pale gleam on the edges; dark brown oak beams in the joints and dark oak shield planks; a rough mid-grey stone fist and stone feet; one dull red gem in the chest; a black eye slit; black gaps between the plates.
wears: It wears nothing over its own body of bronze, oak and stone.
holds: It holds no weapon and its one hand is empty. Its left arm ends in exactly one great round oak-and-bronze shield, the only shield. Its right arm ends in one empty grey stone fist with no shield on it.
pose: It strides to the left on two legs with its front knee bent, hunched low, its left arm pushing the one great round shield out ahead of it on the left side of the picture, its right stone fist drawn back and raised high on the right side of the picture, plainly seen with nothing on it, body braced behind the shield.
must_show: a hulking hunched made thing like an empty suit of old dark bronze armour, riveted plates with black gaps: heavy and grim, not a toy
one great round shield of oak planks with a bronze rim and boss built onto the left arm
a small plain closed bronze helm sunk between the shoulders, one eye slit, no face
one red gem in the chest plate
a grey stone right fist, empty, no weapon
old, dark and dull: not a living knight in shiny armour

what: a bone golem: a massive hunched construct lashed together from the big bones of many different beasts, with no muscle and no flesh anywhere, dark empty gaps showing between the bones. Its head is one great bear's skull: a long heavy snout, a low flat brow with no horns, a wide jaw with four big fangs. Its chest is a wide cage of a few huge curved ribs with black gaps between them, hung on a thick knobbed spine. Each shoulder is a broad flat shoulder-blade bone. Each arm is a bundle of three long thick leg bones lashed side by side with dark cord, ending in a great knot of knucklebones for a fist; the arms are long and reach below its knees. Each leg is a short bundle of thick thighbones on a broad foot of splayed bones. The bones are few, large and bold, each one plainly a bone, and they do not match each other in size.
colours: pale ivory-grey and old brown-stained bone on every part, black gaps between the bones, dark brown sinew cord lashings; not yellow, not gold.
wears: It wears nothing: it is bare lashed bone from head to foot.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing: two great fists of knotted bones.
pose: Seen turned to the left, it stomps to the left on two short legs, hunched far forward so its back is a high arch and the bear skull hangs low out in front with its jaws open, its right bone fist raised high above its back to slam down, its left fist swung low and forward near the ground.
must_show: a hunched construct of big mismatched beast bones lashed with cord, dark gaps between them
a bear's skull for a head: long snout, fangs, no horns
a wide cage of huge ribs
long arms made of bundles of bones with knotted bone fists, one raised
no flesh, no muscle
far bulkier and stranger than a human skeleton

what: a stone golem: an ancient colossal guardian statue carved by masons from grey granite in the likeness of a helmeted sentinel, come to life. Every part of it is rough speckled granite. It is a carved statue of armour, not of a body: it shows no muscles and no skin. Its head is a carved stone helm, a heavy rounded granite dome with a flat stone face-plate, two narrow dark carved eye slots and a carved ridge down the middle; no face shows. Its chest is one massive carved granite breastplate, broad and deep, with a worn carved band across it. Its shoulders are two great rounded carved stone shoulder-plates. Its forearms are thick granite pillars ending in enormous carved stone gauntlet fists, far thicker than its legs. A carved stone skirt of broad flat plates hangs to its knees, and below it stand two thick pillar legs on broad flat stone feet. The stone is old and worn: chisel marks, chipped corners, one long crack across the breastplate and one across an arm, pitted weathered faces, and dark seams where the great carved pieces meet at the shoulders, elbows, waist and knees. It has a small head for its body.
colours: speckled mid-grey and dark charcoal-grey granite on every part with pale grey chipped edges and worn highlights, black cracks, seams and eye slots, a few small patches of dull ochre lichen; no other colour.
wears: It wears nothing over its carved stone: helm, breastplate and skirt are all part of the same granite statue.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing: two enormous granite fists.
pose: It strides to the left on two legs with a ponderous step, front knee bent, its right fist drawn far back and high behind its shoulder for a great punch, its left fist thrust out low ahead, its head turned to the left, the whole body leaning into the blow.
must_show: a massive statue of grey granite carved as a helmeted armoured sentinel, every part stone
a carved stone helm with two dark eye slots, no face
chisel marks, chips, cracks and weathering: old carved stone, painted with weight
enormous empty stone gauntlet fists
no muscles: carved plates and pillars
told from the clay golem at a glance: grey, hard-edged, cracked

what: an arcane golem: a wizard's war golem, a massive brute figure made of dark fired clay, hard as pottery, twice as broad as a man, hunched and neckless. Every part of it is the same dark charcoal-grey fired clay, smooth and heavy, with chipped edges and a web of hairline cracks. Its body is one huge smooth bulging mass of dark clay, widest at the shoulders, with no muscles drawn on it. Its head is small for its body, a smooth blank dark clay lump sunk between the great round shoulders, with no features at all except three big glowing letters in a row across its forehead. Its arms are enormous, thicker than its legs and reaching to its knees, swelling into great club-like clay fists. Its legs are short thick clay pillars on broad flat pads. Large letters of magic script are cut deep into the clay and glow bright cyan-white: the three on the forehead, one column of four big letters down the middle of the chest, and two rings of letters round each great forearm. A few of the hairline cracks near the letters glow faintly with the same light, and short cyan-white sparks crackle around its leading fist, touching it. Between the lights the clay stays dark charcoal-grey.
colours: dark charcoal-grey fired clay on every part with dull grey-brown chipped edges, large bright cyan-white glowing letters on the forehead, chest and forearms, a few faint cyan-white glowing cracks, short cyan-white sparks at one fist. The clay is charcoal-grey, never purple and never brown leather.
wears: It wears nothing: it is bare inscribed fired clay from top to bottom.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing: two great bare dark clay fists, the leading one crackling with short cyan-white sparks.
pose: It lunges to the left on its two pillar legs, its whole mass leaning forward, its right fist punching straight out ahead to the left with sparks around it, its left fist drawn back and raised behind, its small head lowered between its shoulders.
must_show: a massive hunched brute made wholly of dark charcoal fired clay, head included
large glowing cyan-white letters on forehead, chest and forearms, readable as glowing marks in the small sprite
a small blank head with no face, only the glowing letters
great bare clay fists, empty, one punching with sparks
plainly a made thing of clay, not a man in armour
darker and more magical than the plain clay golem
must_not_show: glowing aura round the whole body

what: an iron golem: a colossal forged guardian in the shape of a giant armoured man, the heaviest and grandest of all golems, with nothing inside it but iron. Every part of it is thick black wrought iron, the head included: a vast barrel chest of overlapping forged plates with rows of big dome-headed rivets, huge layered round shoulder plates, arms and legs of thick iron tubes and plates jointed with heavy iron pins, and enormous iron gauntlet fists as big as its head. Its head is a great closed iron helm with a tall ridged crest, a dark T-shaped eye slit with a dull orange furnace glow deep inside, and a barred grille where the mouth would be. A short thick wisp of sickly yellow-green gas leaks from the grille, touching it. The iron is old: hammer marks, deep scratches, dents, and streaks of orange-brown rust running down from the rivets and joints. It has a small head for its body and enormously wide shoulders.
colours: black and dark gunmetal-grey wrought iron on every part with cold steel-grey worn edges and highlights, a few thin orange-brown rust streaks below the rivets, a dull orange glow inside the eye slit, one small wisp of yellow-green gas at the mouth grille. The iron is black-grey, not brown.
wears: It wears nothing over its own body of forged iron plates.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing: two enormous iron gauntlet fists.
pose: It strides to the left on two legs with an earth-shaking step, front knee bent, both huge iron fists raised together high above its helm to slam down, its helm tilted down to the left, the small wisp of gas trailing from its grille.
must_show: a colossal armoured man-shape of black riveted iron, every part iron, head included
rivets, dents and orange-brown rust streaks: old forged metal, painted with weight
closed crested helm with a glowing eye slit and a mouth grille
a small wisp of yellow-green gas at the grille
enormous empty iron fists raised
the grandest golem: heavier and more imposing than the stone and arcane golems

what: Medusa the Gorgon of Greek myth, the cursed queen herself, a monster and the mother of monsters: a tall, gaunt, hunched and terrible woman-shaped creature standing on two legs, nothing like a living lady. Her skin is cold ash-grey, the grey of a stone statue, on her face, neck, arms and hands alike, with patches of dark green-black snake scales on her cheeks, neck and the backs of her arms, a colour no living woman has. Her face is the gorgon mask from an old Greek shield: broad and fierce, with a heavy scowling brow, a flat wide nose, two huge round glaring eyes filled to the brim with solid yellow light, and a very wide mouth stretched open in a snarl from cheek to cheek, showing a row of teeth and two long white tusks curving up from the lower jaw. She has no hair: growing from her whole scalp in its place are seven very thick living snakes, each as thick as her arm, dark emerald-green with pale yellow bellies and big wedge-shaped heads, rearing up and outward in different directions with their white mouths gaping wide. Her arms are long and sinewy, her forearms are covered in dark green-black scales, and her fingers end in long hooked bronze claws. She has a small head, long limbs and a stooped back, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold ash-grey skin with dark green-black scales; seven thick dark emerald-green snakes with pale yellow bellies and white mouths; huge solid glowing yellow eyes; white tusks; a long dark wine-crimson gown, tattered at the hem, with a tarnished gold border; a corselet of dark bronze scales; a tarnished gold snake diadem and armbands; bronze claws.
wears: She wears the ruined finery of a queen: a long, heavy, dark wine-crimson gown with sleeves to the elbow that covers her from the neck to the ankles. Its skirt is whole and closed all the way round from the waist to the ankles, a single unbroken bell of heavy cloth that hides both legs completely; only the last hand's breadth of the hem is torn into ragged points, and a tarnished gold border runs just above the tears; over it a heavy corselet of dark bronze scales from her collar to her hips; a wide dark leather belt; and a tarnished gold diadem shaped like a rearing snake across her brow, and broad tarnished gold armbands.
holds: Her hands are empty and she holds nothing: two grey scaled hands with long hooked bronze claws, fingers spread wide.
pose: She lunges to the left on two legs under the gown, hunched far forward, both long arms thrust out ahead with the hooked claws spread to seize, her head thrust forward and low with the yellow eyes glaring and the tusked mouth wide open, every snake of her hair rearing outward and striking, the torn gown dragging behind.
must_show: a monster, not a lady: a hunched grey-skinned gorgon with a broad fierce mask of a face, huge glowing yellow eyes and a tusked snarling mouth
seven very thick dark green snakes for hair, readable as snakes in the small sprite
long dark crimson gown with tattered hem, fully clothed from neck to ankles
dark bronze scale corselet and tarnished gold diadem: a boss, a ruined queen
empty hooked bronze claws, both reaching
legs under the gown, not a snake's tail; plainly more monstrous than the pale-dressed lesser medusa
must_not_show: snake tail for a lower body
skirt split open at the front

what: a greater imp: a small, lean, sinewy, mean old devil in flight, with tough brick-red leathery skin, a narrow sly wrinkled face with a long pointed chin, a sharp-toothed sneer, slanted yellow eyes, long pointed ears, and two short curved black horns. It has a pair of hard leathery bat wings with dark bony ribs, thin wiry arms ending in long black talons, bent legs with clawed feet, and one tail as thick as its arm: the tail rises behind its back, curves forward high above its head, and ends in front of its horns in one big black barbed stinger the size of its fist, wet with yellow venom. It is small but fully grown and wicked: thin limbs, a small head, a hard knotted body.
colours: brick-red leathery skin, dark maroon wing membranes with black ribs, black horns, talons and stinger, yellow eyes, a frayed dark grey waistcoat with two brass buttons. The tail is brick-red and thick; the stinger is black.
wears: It wears only one shabby, frayed, dark grey waistcoat with two brass buttons, hanging open, the worn finery of a third-rate ambassador. It has no armour and no hat.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing: two thin hands with long black talons, spread to slash.
pose: It swoops to the left in mid-air with both wings spread up behind it, its legs tucked under, both taloned hands reaching forward to slash, its thick tail curled up from behind and forward over the top of its head so the big black barbed stinger hangs above and in front of its horns, pointing to the left, mouth open in a sneer.
must_show: a small lean red winged devil in flight
a thick tail arched over the head ending in one big barbed stinger, readable in the small sprite
hard leathery bat wings, small horns
empty taloned hands
a shabby grey waistcoat
wicked and wiry, not a cute cartoon imp

what: a greater shadow: a great hungry shade of the dead. It is one tall torn shroud of soot-black smoke hanging in the air with nothing inside it, black as coal and never brown or pale grey, taller than a man and widest at the top, drawn wholly inside the picture with plain backdrop on all four sides of it. It is painted with depth: heavy hanging folds, coal-black in the folds and dark slate-grey only on the ridges, with one thin bright line of cold pale light along its left edge, and all its edges fray into short curling wisps of the same black smoke that stay joined to it. Near the top of the shroud are its two eyes, the two brightest things in the picture: two narrow slanted slits of cold white light with no pupils, each as long as a quarter of the shroud is wide. Above the eyes the top of the shroud is torn into a ring of five tall ragged points, like a broken crown of smoke. Out of the front of the shroud reach two long thin streamers of the same black smoke, and each ends in five long hooked claws of pale bone-white, each claw as long as a dagger, plainly seen. The bottom of the shroud is torn into a few broad ragged tatters that taper to points.
colours: coal-black and dark slate-grey smoke, one thin line of cold pale grey-white light along the left edge, two bright white eye slits, ten long pale bone-white claws; no other colour.
wears: It wears nothing: it is itself a shroud of smoke, with nothing inside.
holds: It holds nothing: its two sets of pale bone claws are empty and spread.
pose: It swoops to the left through the air, its crowned top bent forward, one clawed streamer stretched out to the left and low with the pale claws spread to grasp, the other raised beside its head with claws hooked, the white eye slits fixed on the viewer, its torn lower tatters trailing down and to the right. The whole of it, claws and tatters too, is inside the picture.
must_show: one tall torn shroud of coal-black smoke with heavy painted folds, nothing inside it
two bright white slanted eye slits near the top, under a ragged crown of smoke points
two reaching streamers ending in long pale bone claws
a thin pale lit edge; coal-black folds with slate-grey ridges
no cloth cloak or hood: told from the pilot wraith; grim, not a comic-book monster
must_not_show: anything touching the edge of the picture

what: a greater wyvern: the two-legged dragon of heraldry, an old and heavy one, a real flying reptile seen from the side, shaped like a pterodactyl with a dragon's head. Its wings are its arms, like a bat's: two broad leathery wings stretched on long thick finger bones, and it has no other front limbs; its chest is a smooth keel of pale plated scales. It has exactly two legs, thick scaly hind legs with big hooked black talons, set far back under its hips. It has a thick strong neck and a long heavy dragon's head with two long straight black horns sweeping back from the skull and a jaw of big sharp teeth, and a row of tall black spines runs down its neck and back. Its scales are large, old, scarred and heavy. Its long thick scaly tail swings down and forward beneath its body in a hook. The last part of the tail is its sting: there the tail swells into one fat glossy jet-black club, twice as thick as the tail itself and as long as the wyvern's head, which ends in one long curved black spike. The black sting is part of the tail.
colours: dark forest-green scales on the head, neck, back, legs and tail, a pale yellow-tan plated belly and throat, dull dark rust-brown wing membranes on dark green finger bones, black horns, black back spines, a glossy black sting, black talons, amber eyes.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal and holds nothing; both taloned feet are empty and open.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, it flies down to the left through empty air with nothing beneath it, small in the middle of the picture with wide empty backdrop all round, both wings raised above its back and well inside the picture, its two hind legs hanging beneath its hips with the talons hooked, its neck stretched out with the horned head low and the jaws open roaring, and its tail hooked down and forward under its legs with the fat black sting at its tip thrust forward to stab.
must_show: a dragon-like reptile with exactly two legs and two wings, seen from the side, no arms
flying, wings raised, jaws open
a tail hooked forward ending in one fat black sting, readable in the small sprite
dark green heavy scales, back-swept black horns and a row of back spines: plainly the greater kin of the plain grey-brown hornless wyvern
must_not_show: smooth bare skull with no horns
loose black shape above the wings
wing cut off by the edge of the picture

what: a greater demon: a fallen angel who burns without being consumed, a very tall, lean, powerful, proud figure standing on two legs. His whole body is burnt black: skin like charred coal on his face, chest, arms and legs alike, split by thin glowing orange cracks with fire inside. He has a long, severe, once-noble face with hollow cheeks, a grim closed mouth, eyes that are two points of white-orange fire, and two long black horns sweeping back from his brow. From his back spread two great ruined angel's wings: the feathers burnt black and ragged, half of them gone to bare black quills, with a thin line of orange embers glowing along their edges. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, wide shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: charred coal-black skin on every part with thin glowing orange cracks, white-orange burning eyes, black horns, burnt black feathered wings with orange ember edges, a scorched ash-grey robe remnant, a blackened cracked gold collar and belt, orange and yellow flames on the hands.
wears: He wears the scorched remains of an angel's robe, now ash-grey and ragged, hanging from a blackened gold belt at his waist to his shins, and a wide cracked blackened gold collar across his shoulders and upper chest. He has no armour, no crown and no halo.
holds: His hands are empty and he holds no weapon. Each hand is a long black claw wrapped in orange and yellow flame, the fire touching the fingers.
pose: He lunges to the left on two legs, his body turned side-on to the left and leaning forward, front knee bent and back leg stretched behind. His left arm is thrust straight out to the left at shoulder height, far from his body, the burning claws spread to seize. His right arm is raised high above his head, the burning hand ready to rake down. His burnt wings are swept up and back behind him, head lowered and glaring to the left.
must_show: a tall horned figure with charred black skin and glowing orange cracks, head included
two ruined, burnt, feathered angel's wings with ember edges (feathers, not bat wings)
both empty clawed hands burning
scorched ash-grey robe and blackened gold collar
proud and grim: a fallen angel, not a red beast
must_not_show: arms hanging down at the sides
both hands low beside the hips

what: a greater mimic: an old mimic that has outgrown chests, the greater kin of the plain plank-chest mimic and plainly the same kind, caught at the moment it bites, painted seriously with weight and grime. It is one tall, heavy, battered old wardrobe of rough grey-brown weathered oak planks, scarred and stained, with a plain flat top, big rusty iron strap hinges and rusty iron ring handles, and no carving. Its two tall doors have swung wide open, one to each side, and the wardrobe is a pair of jaws standing on end: down the whole inner edge of each door, and along the top and the bottom of the opening, runs a crowded row of very long, thick, uneven yellowed fangs, like the teeth of a great trap, and a second row of shorter fangs stands behind the first. The inside is a deep dark gullet of wet dark flesh, almost black at the back, with no lips anywhere: the fangs grow straight out of the wood. Between the two doors stretch a dozen thick sagging strings of pale amber glue, and fat beads of the same amber glue ooze down the planks. It has no eyes. From low in the gullet one thick whip of dark sinew, studded with pale bone barbs, lashes straight out to the left and ends in a hooked bone barb.
colours: rough grey-brown weathered oak planks, dark brown rusty iron hinges and ring handles the colour of an old nail, long yellowed ivory fangs, a dark brown-black wet gullet, thick pale amber-yellow glue strands and beads, one dark brown whip of sinew with pale bone barbs.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side: the wardrobe lurches forward and to the left, tilted on one corner with its doors flung wide, the two rows of fangs gaping, the amber glue strings stretching between the doors, the barbed whip of sinew lashing straight out to the left. It has nothing under it.
must_show: a tall plank wardrobe (not a chest) with both doors open, that is a monster
long yellowed fangs down the door edges and round the opening, far more teeth than the plain mimic, readable in the small sprite
a dark gullet with no lips
amber glue strands like the plain mimic's
weathered, stained, painted wood: serious, not comic

what: a grave guardian: the walking corpse of a knight who died centuries ago and still keeps his oath to guard a crypt, a tall, thin, dried-out mummified dead man standing on two legs. He is a corpse, not a living man: his skin is dead, dark grey-brown and dry as old leather, shrunk tight onto the bones of his face, neck and hands, never living pink or tan. His bare head is a corpse's head: skin shrunk onto the skull, the nose withered to a ridge, the cheeks sunk into deep hollows, the lips dried back from long yellow teeth in a fixed grimace, a few long wisps of white hair, and deep dark eye sockets each holding one small steady point of pale gold light. His hands are bones wrapped in dry dark skin. Rusted mail covers his arms to the wrists and hangs below his surcoat to his knees. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long thin limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: dead dark grey-brown leathery skin on the head and hands, yellow teeth, wisps of white hair, two small pale gold eye lights, a tattered bone-white burial surcoat stained grey, dark rusted brown-grey mail on the arms and below the surcoat, a long sword with a dull grey notched blade and a plain iron cross-guard, worn dark leather boots and belt.
wears: He wears a long-sleeved shirt of dark rusted mail that covers his arms to the wrists and hangs to his knees, and over it a tattered, plain, sleeveless bone-white burial surcoat, stained and torn at the hem, belted with a worn dark leather belt; and worn dark leather boots. The surcoat is plain with no emblem. His head is bare: he has no helmet and no hood. He has no shield.
holds: He holds exactly one long straight sword in both hands: his two fists are clasped together, one above the other, on the sword's long grip, and the broad dull grey notched blade rises straight up from his fists above his head. It has a plain straight iron cross-guard. Both hands are on this one sword and he holds nothing else.
pose: He lunges forward to the left on two legs with his front knee deeply bent and his back leg straight, both arms raised with his two fists together above his right shoulder gripping the sword, the blade pointing up and back ready to chop down, his dead face turned to the left with the teeth bared.
must_show: a mummified corpse of a knight: dark dried skin shrunk on the skull, teeth bared, bare head with white wisps (not a living man, not a clean skeleton)
two small pale gold eye lights
tattered bone-white surcoat over rusted mail sleeves and skirt
one long sword gripped in both hands, raised
no shield, no helmet
a solemn dead champion, plainer than the tomb guardian

what: a tomb guardian: the walking corpse of a picked soldier of an ancient king, sealed in the tomb with his lord centuries ago and still on guard, a strong, broad, upright dead warrior standing on two legs. He is a corpse, not a living man: his skin is dead, pale ash-grey like stone dust and cracked like dry mud, on his face, neck and hands alike, never living pink or tan. His face is a dead man's face: grey skin drawn tight over the cheekbones, sunken cheeks, dark hollows round blank milk-white eyes with no pupils, grey lips drawn back from clenched yellow teeth, a thin drooping black moustache, and black hair bound up in a tight topknot on the crown of his head. His hands are grey and bony. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, wide shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: dead pale ash-grey cracked skin on the face and hands, blank white eyes, black topknot and moustache, armour of small dull brown-gold bronze plates laced with faded dark red cord, dusty and tarnished, a long faded dark red tunic, a wide brown leather belt, dark brown boots, a glaive with a dark red wooden pole and a broad grey blade.
wears: He wears ancient soldier's armour made of many small square dull bronze plates laced together in rows with faded dark red cord, covering his chest, shoulders and upper arms and hanging in a skirt to his thighs, over a long faded dark red tunic with wide sleeves, with a wide brown leather belt and dark brown boots. His head is bare with the topknot showing. He has no shield.
holds: He holds exactly one glaive in both hands: a thick dark red wooden pole taller than he is, topped with one big broad curved single-edged grey blade as long as his arm. Both hands grip the pole and he holds nothing else.
pose: He lunges to the left on two legs in a deep trained soldier's stance, front knee bent and back leg straight, both hands sweeping the glaive forward so its big curved blade is high and clear on the left of his head, his grey face set and staring.
must_show: a corpse soldier: ash-grey dead skin on face and hands, blank white eyes, teeth bared, black topknot
armour of rows of small bronze plates laced with red cord, readable as plated armour
one glaive (long pole, big curved blade) in both hands
red tunic under the armour
a drilled, armoured soldier: better armed than the grave guardian

what: an Anubis guardian: an ancient Egyptian temple statue of the god Anubis come to life, a tall, lean, broad-shouldered man's body with the head of a black jackal, carved from one block of glossy black basalt stone. Every part of it is black stone, the head included: a long slender jackal's muzzle, two very tall upright pointed ears, a strong neck, a bare carved chest, long arms and legs. It is a statue: hard polished faces of stone, sharp carved edges, a few chips at the ears and knuckles and one long crack across the chest. Its eyes are two inlaid almond shapes of gold. Its collar, armbands, wrist bands and kilt are carved from the same stone and covered in gold leaf, some of it worn away. It has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: glossy jet-black basalt stone on the head, body and limbs with cold grey highlights on the polished edges, gold-leaf collar, armbands and kilt with worn dull patches, a striped gold and black stone headcloth, gold inlaid eyes.
wears: It wears, carved in stone and gilded: a broad Egyptian collar of gold across its shoulders and chest, a striped gold and black headcloth falling behind its ears to its shoulders, gold bands on its upper arms and wrists, and a pleated gold knee-length Egyptian kilt with a long front panel. Its feet are bare black stone.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing: its right hand points forward with one finger in judgment, its left hand is a clenched black stone fist.
pose: It strides to the left on two legs with one foot far forward, its right arm stretched straight out ahead pointing one finger in judgment, its left fist drawn back at its hip, its jackal head thrust forward with the jaws open showing white stone fangs.
must_show: a jackal-headed man with two tall upright ears, on two legs
made wholly of glossy black stone: a living statue, chipped and cracked, head included
gold Egyptian collar, kilt and armbands
gold inlaid eyes
empty hands: one pointing, one fist
told from the stone golem at a glance: black, slender, polished, gilded

what: a dryad guardian: an oak nymph of Greek myth, a slender, graceful, fierce young woman standing on two legs, her body half tree. She has a fine stern lovely face with smooth pale tan skin the colour of new wood, amber eyes and a mouth open in a shout of warning. In place of hair a thick mane of dark green oak leaves grows from her head and falls past her shoulders, with a few acorns in it. From her elbows to her fingertips and from her knees to her feet her limbs are rough brown oak bark, and her fingers are long bark twigs. From her right forearm grows one thick, long, twisting brown root. She has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: pale tan skin like new wood on the face, neck and upper arms, rough brown oak bark on the forearms, hands, shins and feet, a mane of dark green oak leaves with brown acorns, amber eyes, a dress of layered green and russet-orange oak leaves with a braided brown bark belt, one thick brown root.
wears: She wears a modest dress made of many overlapping oak leaves, dark green at the shoulders shading to russet-orange at the hem, covering her from her collarbone to her knees, with short leaf sleeves and a belt of braided brown bark. She has no armour and no jewellery.
holds: Her hands are empty and she holds nothing. Her left hand points forward with one bark finger. From her right forearm one thick brown root as thick as her wrist grows out and lashes forward in a long curve; it is part of her arm, not a held thing.
pose: She strides to the left on two legs with one foot forward, her left arm stretched straight out ahead pointing with one finger, her right arm swung up and forward with the thick root growing from it lashing out in a curve above her pointing hand, her leaf hair blown back, mouth open in a cry.
must_show: a slender woman, part tree: bark forearms and shins, pale wood-tan face
a mane of oak leaves for hair
a dress of green and russet leaves, fully clothed to the knees
one hand pointing, empty
one thick root growing from her right forearm, lashing out
fierce and fey, a guardian, not a walking tree

what: a naga guardian: a serpent lord of Indian legend, one enormous real king cobra, thick as a tree trunk, reared up tall. Its long heavy body rises from one tight stack of two thick coils into a tall upright S-curved neck, and near the top the neck flares into one very wide flat cobra hood, as broad as the coils below. On the hood sits a real cobra's head: a blunt scaled snout, a wide open mouth with two long white fangs and a forked tongue, and fierce round amber eyes with slit pupils. On the top of its head it wears a small ornate gold crown with one red gem, and two broad gold rings circle its neck just below the hood. Its scales are big, heavy and glossy, each one painted.
colours: dark bronze-brown glossy scales on the back with black edges, a pale cream belly with broad bands, the inside of the hood cream with one dark brown spectacle mark, amber eyes, white fangs, a dark red mouth, a gold crown with one red gem, two gold neck rings.
wears: It wears one small ornate gold crown with a red gem on top of its head and two broad gold rings round its neck below the hood, and nothing else.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: It rears tall and sways to the left, its neck curved in an S and its wide hood spread flat facing the viewer, its head tilted down to the left with the jaws wide open and fangs bared to strike, the end of its tail flicking up out of the coils on the right.
must_show: one giant cobra, reared up tall, with a wide spread hood, readable in the small sprite
a real snake's head with open fanged jaws
a small gold crown on the head and gold rings on the neck: a serpent lord, not a plain snake
bronze-brown scales, cream belly
coils only at the base: nothing under it but its own body

what: an Egyptian sphinx: a living sphinx on four legs, seen from the side. Its head is the head of a human king, a man: a flat human face with smooth bronze-brown human skin, a straight human nose, human lips, a strong human chin and jaw, and calm stern dark-lined human eyes, clean-shaven, exactly the face of a pharaoh on a gold funeral mask. The head wears a pharaoh's striped headcloth of gold and deep blue stripes that covers the hair and hangs in two broad flaps down to the chest, with a small gold cobra rearing at the brow, and a narrow straight braided dark false beard on the human chin. From the neck down its body is the whole body of a huge, heavy, powerful real lion: deep chest, thick legs, great paws with claws, and a long tail with a dark tuft, covered in short golden-tan fur. The fur stops at the neck: the face is bare human skin.
colours: short golden-tan lion's fur on the body with a cream belly, a dark brown tail tuft, a bronze-brown human face, a gold and deep blue striped headcloth, a gold brow cobra, a broad gold and turquoise collar on the chest, dark eyes.
wears: It wears a pharaoh's gold and deep blue striped headcloth with a small gold cobra at the brow, a narrow straight braided false beard, and one broad Egyptian collar of gold and turquoise beads across its lion's chest. It wears nothing else.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side facing left, it stalks forward on four legs with its human head held high and its body low, its left front paw lifted high with the claws spread ready to crush down, the other three paws planted, tail lashing up behind, its human mouth open in a great shout.
must_show: a lion's body on four legs, seen from the side
a human man's face (flat face, human nose and chin, bare skin) under a pharaoh's striped gold and blue headcloth
no wings
one front paw raised to strike
gold collar on the chest
alive and golden, kingly and stern

what: a celestial guardian: one of the cherubim set to guard the way to Eden, a very tall, mighty, stern and beautiful angel standing on two legs, with a calm severe young man's face, level grey eyes, a firm closed mouth and shoulder-length golden hair, his head bare. Behind him spread four separate great white feathered wings that together make the shape of a big letter X with his body at the crossing: one wing points up to the upper left, one wing points up to the upper right, one wing points down to the lower left beside his knee, and one wing points down to the lower right beside his other knee. The two lower wings are as large as the two upper wings and hang down outside his legs, their tips level with his ankles, with a clear gap of backdrop between each upper wing and the lower wing beneath it. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, wide shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: four white feathered wings with pale gold tips, bright polished gold plate armour engraved with fine lines, long white robes with a gold border, a deep crimson sash, golden hair, fair skin, a long sword whose blade is wrapped in orange and yellow flame.
wears: He wears magnificent polished gold plate armour: a breastplate engraved with a sunburst, layered shoulder plates shaped as feathers, gold vambraces and greaves; under it long white robes that fall to his ankles with a wide gold border; a deep crimson sash across his chest from one shoulder; and a thin plain gold circlet on his brow. His head has no helmet.
holds: He holds exactly one long straight broad sword in his right hand, raised, its whole blade wrapped in orange and yellow flame from guard to point, the flame attached to the blade. His left hand is empty and thrust straight out ahead with the palm open and flat, fingers up, barring the way.
pose: He stands barring the way, facing left on two legs with his feet set wide and his front knee bent, his empty left hand thrust straight out ahead at shoulder height with the palm flat and open in a halt, his right arm raised high with the flaming sword lifted above his head ready to strike, the four wings spread behind him in a big X, two pointing up and two pointing down beside his legs, robes blowing back.
must_show: an angel with four white wings in an X: two raised, two swept down
polished engraved gold armour over white robes, crimson sash
one flaming sword raised in the right hand
empty left palm thrust out, barring the way
bare head, calm stern face, golden hair
the grandest guardian: radiant, ornate and imposing, without malice
must_not_show: rays of light filling the picture
